Harry Kane Misses Penalty in Bayern Munich Match

Harry Kane missed a penalty and hit the post during his first match since the Ballon d'Or triumph, which resulted in Bayern Munich being held to a draw by Dortmund. The match saw Kane's team unable to secure a win.
